describes: packages/plugin/stage: the camera tween, rest detector, fling and rubber-band physics over the frame seam.

cases.name: rest-detector
cases.covers: Placement snaps at once; a zoom write afterwards un-rests the camera and a frame chain declares rest after 150 ms of frames, re-armed by each further zoom; pans never un-rest.

cases.name: smooth-navigation-tween
cases.covers: A smooth goToPage tweens x, y and zoom on easeOutCubic over 240 ms, clamping each frame to the target bounds; cameraInMotion reads true until the last frame; the cursor is set up front.

cases.name: caught-tween
cases.covers: Every verb cancels a running tween first: a setCamera mid-flight stops it where it is and no stale frame lands later.

cases.name: smooth-scroll-and-reveal
cases.covers: A smooth scrollTo tweens and syncs the cursor only on arrival; a smooth bare reveal tweens against the scene; a smooth positioned reveal commits its zoom intent then tweens.

cases.name: animated-double-tap
cases.covers: doubleTapZoom tweens the zoom geometrically around the tapped point, holding it fixed each frame, syncs the cursor on arrival; a tap mid-tween climbs from where the intent says it was going.

cases.name: fling-glide-and-bounce
cases.covers: fling glides on the UIScrollView decay, syncing the cursor each frame; reaching an edge converts to a critically-damped spring that lands exactly on the clamp; a fitting axis discards its velocity; a slow fling starts nothing; a gesture catches a glide.

cases.name: elastic-release-springs-home
cases.covers: An elastic gesture held past the edge springs home on release; catching it mid-bounce holds the stretch and hands it back to the finger through the inverse curve; a release inside the bounds starts nothing.

cases.name: gesture-holds-the-rest-countdown
cases.covers: A zoom inside a gesture un-rests at once and cancels the countdown; endGesture commits the level and arms it.

cases.name: fling-on-a-short-wide-page
cases.covers: A fling over a page that fits vertically but travels horizontally glides only on x.

cases.name: zoomed-fling
cases.covers: At zoom 2 the integrator works in screen px: positions scale by the zoom once, the edge conversion compares in px; a release of exactly 20 px/s still glides.

cases.name: a-caught-stretch-at-the-asymptote
cases.covers: Catching a spring that starts from a stretch at the rubber asymptote caps the overshoot one px under the viewport dimension, so the inverse stays finite.

cases.name: zoomed-out-bounce
cases.covers: Below zoom 1 a bounce off the far edges clamps the true position each frame, on both travelling axes.

cases.name: pages-vanish-mid-tween
cases.covers: A double-tap tween whose document loses every page mid-flight skips its frames over the empty scene.

cases.name: paged-reveal-tweens
cases.covers: A bare reveal in paged flow navigates with the reveal behavior: smooth tweens even when the setting is instant.

cases.name: fit-all-with-frames
cases.covers: Under fit-all with frames, next and prev tween the whole scene and resizes re-place at once.
